$comment: Launch gates as code (tracking: https://gitlab.com/authichain-group/authichain-unified/-/work_items/1987). Run by scripts/autonomy/launch-gates.mjs. FAIL CLOSED: a gate passes only with positive evidence. `pending` gates always FAIL until implemented. kill_switch=true stands the runner down (no probes, no issues). Protection of this file is NOT enforced by CODEOWNERS alone: it depends on branch protection requiring owner approval and on keeping merge_autopilot away from this path.

promotion.$comment: Consumed by Gate 5 (not yet implemented). Order in which hosts go public; the next host is promoted when gates 1-4 stay green for green_window_hours.

gates.title: CI executes and is green (steps ran, not just 'no failures')
gates.evidence_required: GitLab (primary): the latest real run of each listed job on the default branch is success, has a nonzero duration and is newer than max_age_days. GitHub (when Actions is unlocked): latest completed run per workflow succeeded and every job has executed steps.

gates.title: Public hosts reachable (no Cloudflare Access redirect)
gates.evidence_required: Every probe returned the expected status within budget with no redirect to the forbidden host.

gates.title: Protocol round trip: sign, verify, tamper (shipped verifier, Ed25519 did:key + JCS)
gates.evidence_required: An independent signer issues fresh records; protocol/verifier.mjs verifies valid and anchored records, rejects tampering, wrong issuer key, altered anchor hash, expiry and testnet anchors, ignores key order, and verifies the published example records.

gates.title: Protocol conformance suite passes against the reference verifier
Public verify/resolver endpoint serves a known-good record within budget
gates.evidence_required: GET the published example returns 200, verdict verified, source published_example, within max_ms. protocol/verifier.mjs verifies the shipped example, and the live subject id matches that record.

gates.title: Checkout and Stripe webhook health (DPP Readiness)
gates.evidence_required: Test-mode checkout completes; webhook enabled with required events.

gates.title: Auto-promotion by host, auto-rollback, circuit breakers
gates.evidence_required: Rollback drill executed; breakers trip and re-arm.

gates.title: Estate inventory: every off-repo Worker has an explicit decision (repo-side, no token)
gates.evidence_required: config/estate.json has no 'unknown' dispositions, only archive/retire/unrelated, and every archive path exists.

gates.title: Estate live drift: no live Worker without source or inventory entry
gates.evidence_required: Needs the live Worker list from Cloudflare (read-only API token, intentionally not stored in GitLab). scripts/autonomy/estate-drift.mjs implements the comparison; run it where a read-only token is available.

gates.title: Outreach compliance guardrails
gates.evidence_required: Suppression list, regional rules and breaker tested; gate decides whether cold_outreach may be enabled.

gates.title: Public trust artifacts (spec, open verifier, key registry, status page)
gates.evidence_required: Spec, reference verifier, JWKS, issuer registry, and /api/health are reachable and contain their markers. There is no separate HTML status page.

gates.title: Docs and backlog consolidation
gates.evidence_required: docs/operations consolidated, LAUNCH.md matches this manifest, link check green.
